dish_name: pea and basil risotto with lemon and pine nuts
components: pea and basil risotto with lemon and pine nuts
source: generic recipe written by claude-opus-5-5 from the dish name only; not taken from any recording

steps.component: pea and basil risotto with lemon and pine nuts
steps.text: Fetch the peas from the freezer and the butter, Parmesan, lemon and basil from the fridge
steps.checkpoint: peas, butter, Parmesan, lemon and basil are on the counter

steps.component: pea and basil risotto with lemon and pine nuts
steps.text: Fetch the arborio rice, pine nuts, onion, garlic, wine, stock, oil and seasoning from the pantry
steps.checkpoint: pantry items are on the counter

steps.component: pea and basil risotto with lemon and pine nuts
steps.text: Get out the wide pan, saucepan, small pan, cutting board, knife, ladle, spoon, grater and zester

steps.component: pea and basil risotto with lemon and pine nuts
steps.text: Heat the stock in the saucepan and keep it simmering

steps.component: pea and basil risotto with lemon and pine nuts
steps.text: Toast the pine nuts in the dry small pan until golden

steps.component: pea and basil risotto with lemon and pine nuts
steps.text: Finely chop the onion and garlic

steps.component: pea and basil risotto with lemon and pine nuts
pea and basil risotto with lemon and pine nuts
steps.text: Grate the Parmesan and tear the basil

steps.component: pea and basil risotto with lemon and pine nuts
steps.text: Soften the onion and garlic in oil and half the butter

steps.component: pea and basil risotto with lemon and pine nuts
steps.text: Add the rice and toast for 2 minutes

steps.component: pea and basil risotto with lemon and pine nuts
steps.text: Pour in the wine and stir until absorbed

steps.component: pea and basil risotto with lemon and pine nuts
steps.text: Add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for about 15 minutes

steps.component: pea and basil risotto with lemon and pine nuts
steps.text: Stir in the peas and cook a few more minutes
steps.checkpoint: peas are bright green and rice is al dente

steps.component: pea and basil risotto with lemon and pine nuts
steps.text: Off the heat beat in the remaining butter, Parmesan, lemon zest and juice, basil and seasoning
steps.checkpoint: risotto is creamy and green flecked

steps.component: pea and basil risotto with lemon and pine nuts
steps.text: Plate the risotto and scatter the toasted pine nuts and extra basil on top
steps.checkpoint: risotto is topped with pine nuts
